clans.name: Dukhan

bane.name: The Curse of Reverie
bane.summary: Blood alone can't sustain you. Go as many nights as your Humanity without spending a full scene in the Astral and you become Languid, until you fall into torpor or spend a scene there.

clans.summary: Former Mekhet entangled with the Begotten, who stalk humanity's dreams and travel the Astral more easily than any other Kindred.

bloodlines.name: Bron
bloodlines.summary: Ventrue whose blood was changed by old magic (the Grail, the Cauldron of Rebirth or the fae, depending on who tells it): knights and hermits who hunt the monsters of the wild and court the favor of the fae.

bane.name: The Errant Curse
bane.summary: As well as the Ventrue bane: whenever your permanent Blood Potency changes, all your Touchstones come loose until you defend each attachment again. Each night, roll Humanity for every loose Touchstone; on a failure the Storyteller replaces it with a new one.

disciplines.name: Crochan
disciplines.summary: Bron rites of the blood that speed healing, sharpen the hunt and bind others in oaths.

powers.name: Swift Flows the Blood
powers.summary: Each success lets you spend one more Vitae than Blood Potency allows this turn, for healing only.

powers.name: Blooding the Hunter
powers.summary: Anoint yourself with your quarry's blood: successes (up to 5) add to rolls to track and chase them all night. Works alongside A Taste of Blood.

powers.name: Sealing the Covenant
powers.duration: Until the Touchstone is destroyed or abandoned
powers.summary: Bind willing vampires in a blood oath: each gains an extra Touchstone at Humanity 4 standing for the shared loyalty. Losing it is a breaking point; abandoning it brings Languid.

powers.name: Blood of My Blood
powers.summary: Heal another with Vitae as if healing yourself, aggravated wounds included, or restore a mortal's scars, eyes and limbs. No blood bond.

powers.name: Conquering the Challenge of the Axe
powers.summary: Refuse to yield and take no damage from any source, sunlight included, until you attack, feed on the unwilling, use Disciplines aggressively or frenzy.

disciplines.name: Kimiya
disciplines.summary: Jaliniyya blood alchemy that treats Vitae as an occult science, mixing blood with reagents to work its formulae.

castingCost.note: plus lethal wounds' worth of the subject's blood equal to the formula's dots − 1 (minimum 1); your own if the subject is an object

covenants.name: Legion of the Green
covenants.summary: Allied lords of the Courts of Night, mostly Weihan Cynn and Romans left behind by the Camarilla, bound by blood oaths that will become the Invictus. Its Status counts as Invictus Status for Merits, Oaths included.

covenants.name: Circles of Mor
covenants.summary: Small, feuding covens of feather-cloaked Kindred who worship vengeance, the Beast and sometimes the Strix. Its Status counts as Circle of the Crone Status.

covenants.name: Ahl al-Mumit
covenants.summary: Also called al-Hamasoun. Kindred, mostly Muslim, who rage at their curse and turn it on the wicked, hunting monsters while working Karamat (Theban Sorcery) to remind themselves of God's mercy. They claim Iblis as their teacher.

covenants.name: al-Amin
covenants.summary: Devout storytellers, mediators and caravan-masters who follow Khadijah and Shahrazad, keep the peace between covenants and leave the judgment of their souls to God.

covenants.name: Fir'awn
covenants.summary: A loose alliance of polytheist Kindred who keep the old faiths alive and practise Majnun (Crúac) as forerunners of the Circle of the Crone. They may take Altar as though they were Acolytes.

covenants.name: Jaliniyya
covenants.summary: Scholar-alchemists descended from a Camarilla sect of Galenic physicians, who study Vitae by experiment and teach the blood alchemy of Kimiya.

merits.name: Contracts of Night and Day
merits.summary: Invoke Invictus Oaths between a Kindred liege and a changeling vassal, who drinks your Vitae for a first-stage blood bond and can use Contracts on you as if through a Loophole.

merits.name: Faith Militant
merits.summary: Your flock serves you: treat Herd as Resources for services, and once a chapter for equipment.

merits.name: Parliament's Apostle
merits.summary: Your coven worships one of the Strix. Once a chapter, ask it for knowledge as a Mentor of your Circle of Mor Status, or a Dread Power of up to that Potency, paying twice your Status in Vitae; raising Humanity puts you at its mercy.

merits.name: Ifrit's Might
merits.summary: Choose one Majnun (Crúac) rite for each dot of Blood Potency above 5: leading it, three successes count as exceptional. New Blood Potency dots add rites.

merits.name: Lingering Dreams
merits.summary: When you interpret a dream vision about someone, they dream of you in turn and become Swooning for you.

merits.name: Shahrazad's Tale
merits.summary: Once a chapter, an hour-long tale can hook up to your dots in listeners (Resolve + Composure, −1 per dot): they become addicted to your Vitae and your stories, and think better of you with each tale.

devotions.name: Nightmare Journey
devotions.summary: Send your mind from Twilight Projection into a Chamber of the local Hive in a Dream Form that can use Disciplines and feed on dream creatures, while your body lies in true torpor.

rituals.name: Spider's Hijra
rituals.summary: Spin your Vitae into webs filling Potency × 10 yards around you until sunrise, penalising Initiative, Defense, Speed and Physical pools of everyone but you.

rituals.name: Sayih's Khol
rituals.summary: Words in blood on the subject's eyelids protect them from currents, pressure and waves for the night; the living can breathe underwater.

rituals.name: al-Ajsad
rituals.summary: Make a loyal homunculus from your Vitae, corpse parts, mercury and sulfur; it lives as long as you feed it a Vitae each night.

rituals.name: Ebony Horse
rituals.summary: Runes in blood make an object of up to Size 7 fly and carry passengers until sunrise, at twice the formula's Potency in Speed, wherever you direct it.

rituals.name: Curse of the Monkey Prince
rituals.summary: Drink a potion of the victim's blood and name a wrong they mean to do you; if they do it before sunrise, they're turned into a small animal until dawn.

conditions.name: Hunted
conditions.summary: One of the Strix has taken an interest in you, whether to destroy you or simply to torment you.
conditions.resolution: Stop your persecutors by a bargain, a change of habits that keeps them from you, or force.
